reference_role.note: nothing in the endpoint states whether these energies are meant as SER, as an ordered-compound reference, or as plain DFT totals. The energies are absolute DFT total energies of the 2-atom cell; no reference state is written anywhere.

energy_reference_state.note: no SER/GHSER relation and no elemental reference is present, so eV/cell cannot be converted to a formation quantity from this endpoint alone.
